docs.title: 🛰 Legendary OSINT
docs.text:
A curated, community-maintained collection of OSINT tools, guides, and resources.

This site collects useful public tools and references from newsletters, startpages, community lists, and open repositories — curated for investigators, researchers, and privacy-conscious users.

⚠️ Most links point to third-party services. Vet tools before use and follow legal/ethical guidelines.

Quick links

  • People search & social media: people-social.md
  • Domains, IPs & infrastructure: infra-domains.md
  • Search engines & dorking: search-engines.md
  • Imagery & reverse search: image-reverse.md
  • Maritime & aviation tracking: maritime.md / aviation.md

Contributing

If you'd like to add resources, correct links, or improve categorization, please open a pull request. See the repository's contributing guidelines for help: CONTRIBUTING.md

Want to preview locally? Install Python 3.8+, then:

pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs serve
